genericProblem: A repository control can classify a tool name correctly while the active client does not dispatch the corresponding lifecycle event, so the declared control exceeds its observable capability.

counterexamples.evidence: The real Agent patch receipt records exact path, before hash, after hash and invocation id.
The real 0.145.0 functions.exec canary changed its file but produced zero COMMAND_SNAPSHOT pre/post receipts.
write-channel-reconcile-self-test creates a receipt-bound governed delta, removes its post receipt, and verifies the exact red reason INCREMENTAL_RECEIPT_CHAIN_MISSING.

findings.genericProblem: Tool classification is not proof of client event dispatch.
A direct command write can bypass immediate hook evidence, but an independent baseline-to-current receipt chain detects the missing edge before package exit.
